reason: I'll install the open-source version the day I see it and play with it on a spare Mac mini, but $99 a month for someone else to fire my cron jobs is a hard sell when I already have a box that can do that.
objection: It's pre-alpha from one developer, and most of what it does I can already hack together with cron, claude -p and a GitHub Action. I'm not paying a monthly fee for something that might be abandoned in six months.
would_change_my_mind: If the self-hosted version actually saved my team hours of review every week for a month and the phone approvals were genuinely good, I'd pay for Cloud so I stop babysitting the server.
